# Equifax


> Equifax offers knowledge and services for consumers and businesses regarding credit reports, credit scores, and identity threat monitoring.
> Root map: [https://www.equifax.com/llms.txt](https://www.equifax.com/llms.txt)


---


## Personal Solutions
- [Equifax | Credit Bureau | Check Your Credit](https://www.equifax.com/) - Equifax offers knowledge and services for consumers and businesses regarding credit reports, credit scores, and identity threat monitoring.
- [Equifax Credit and Financial Education | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/) - The Equifax Knowledge Center contains documentation and research about consumer credit scores, consumer credit reports, personal finances, and identity theft protection.
- [Credit and Equifax Products FAQ | Equifax®](https://www.equifax.com/personal/help/) - The Equifax Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) Center provides answers to questions regarding managing consumer credit reports, consumer credit scores, and Equifax products for consumers.
- [Credit Report Services | Equifax®](https://www.equifax.com/personal/credit-report-services/) - Equifax Credit Report Services include freezing consumer credit reports, placing fraud alerts, pulling personal credit reports, and submitting credit report dispute submissions.
- [Daily Credit Score | Equifax Core Credit™ | Equifax®](https://www.equifax.com/personal/products/credit/free-credit-score/) - Equifax Core Credit product provides daily programmatic generation of consumer credit score.
- [Equifax Complete | Monitor Your Credit and Your Identity](https://www.equifax.com/personal/products/monitor-credit-protect-identity/) - Equifax Complete product provides monitoring for consumer credit reports and credit scores as well as consumer identity theft protection.
- [3-Bureau Credit Monitoring and Credit Reports | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/products/credit/monitoring-and-reports/) - Equifax Complete Premier product provides monitoring for consumer credit reports and credit scores from Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion as well as consumer identity theft protection.
- [Family Credit Monitoring and Identity Protection | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/products/family-identity-theft-protection/) - Equifax Complete Family Plan product provides monitoring for consumer credit reports and credit scores from Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion as well as consumer identity theft protection for up to two adults and four children.


---


## Business Solutions
- [Business | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/business/) - Discover how our products drive smarter revenue and deliver exceptional outcomes for a better customer experience. Explore our offerings in credit risk, data-driven marketing, identity and fraud, verification, and workforce management.
- [Credit Risk](https://www.equifax.com/business/credit-risk/) - Enhance consumer credit risk decisions with advanced data, predictive models, and inclusive insights from Equifax.
- [OneScore](https://www.equifax.com/business/product/onescore/) - OneScore from Equifax is a next-generation risk score pairing industry-leading, traditional consumer credit attributes with differentiated alternative data sources — helping you score more consumers and enhance your decisioning power.
- [Identity & Fraud](https://www.equifax.com/business/identity-fraud/) - With identity and fraud services from Equifax, lenders can detect and prevent fraud, verify identities, and safeguard revenue with advanced analytics.
- [Business Credit Reports for Small Business](https://www.equifax.com/business/product/business-credit-reports-small-business) - Get your Equifax business credit report online. Know what banks, lenders, and vendors see. Order your report today and stay in control of your credit.
- [Commercial Data](https://www.equifax.com/business/data-assets/commercial-data) - Optimize risk, verify B2B data, and drive growth with Equifax Commercial Data solutions – a trusted marketing data provider for businesses.
- [Mortgage & Housing](https://www.equifax.com/business/mortgage/) - Streamline mortgage lending with Equifax data, tech integrations, and insights to boost efficiency, accuracy, and borrower experience.
- [Market Pulse](https://www.equifax.com/business/trends-insights/marketpulse/) - Access webinars, reports, podcasts, and more to stay ahead in today's uncertain environment. Join our free Market Pulse webinar series for timely industry insights.


---


## Corporate & News
- [Who We Are](https://www.equifax.com/about-equifax/who-we-are) - Corporate overview of Equifax as a global credit bureau, financial data registry, and technology architecture provider delivering consumer risk analytics, identity verification, and commercial intelligence across enterprise sectors.
- [Newsroom](https://www.equifax.com/newsroom/) - Official corporate newsroom containing press releases, regulatory announcements, executive statements, media relation contact data, and corporate communications assets.
- [EFX.AI](https://www.equifax.com/about-equifax/efx-ai/) - Directory of EFX.AI capabilities, utilizing patented machine learning algorithms, explainable AI models, and predictive data architectures to accelerate credit risk evaluation and expand asset visibility.
- [Security](https://www.equifax.com/about-equifax/security/) - Description of Equifax security posture and the company’s approach to data security in their cloud-native, AI-ready technology infrastructure. Topics include cloud infrastructure protocols, cybersecurity benchmarks, identity and access management (IAM), regulatory compliance certifications, and threat detection.


---


## Optional
The following resources are secondary deep-dive modules grouped by their parent architectures. AI agents can skip these sub-sections if short-context optimization is required by the retrieval engine.


### Related to: Equifax | Credit Bureau | Check Your Credit
- [Business | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/business/) - Discover how our products drive smarter revenue and deliver exceptional outcomes for a better customer experience. Explore our offerings in credit risk, data-driven marketing, identity and fraud, verification, and workforce management.


### Related to: Equifax Credit and Financial Education Hub
- [Credit Score Information: Guide to Credit Scores | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/credit/score/) - The Equifax Credit Score Knowledge Center sub-hub is an educational tool containing articles that relate to credit scores, what affect them, and how to improve them.
- [Understanding Your Equifax Credit Report | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/credit/report/) - The Equifax Credit Report Knowledge Center sub-hub is an educational tool containing articles that relate to credit reports, what is included in them, and how certain credit habits can show up on your credit reports.
- [Identity Theft Information: ID and Credit Fraud | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/identity-theft/) - The Equifax Identity Theft Knowledge Center sub-hub is an educational tool containing articles that relate to identity theft, what to do if your identity is stolen, and how to protect your identity.
- [Financial and Credit Information for all Stages of Life | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/life-stages/) - The Equifax Life Stages Knowledge Center sub-hub is an educational tool containing articles that relate credit and financial advice for specific stages of life, such as college, retirement, marriage, and children.
- [Personal Finance: Budgeting and Money-Saving Tips | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/personal-finance/) - The Equifax Personal Finance Knowledge Center sub-hub is an educational tool containing articles that aim to provide guidance on personal finance best practices.
- [Debt Management Strategies: Paying Off Debt | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/debt-management/) - The Equifax Debt Management Knowledge Center sub-hub is an educational tool containing articles that aim to provide guidance on best practices to understand and manage personal debt.
- [Guide to Credit Cards and Your Credit Scores | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/credit-cards/) - The Equifax Credit Cards Knowledge Center sub-hub is an educational tool containing articles that relate to credit card best practices, what you should consider when it comes to credit cards, and how credit card habits can impact your credit scores.
- [What to Know Before Taking Out Loans | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/loans/) - The Equifax Loans Knowledge Center sub-hub is an educational tool containing articles that relate to different types of loans, best practices when it comes to loans, and how loans can show up on your credit reports and impact your credit scores.
- [Better Protect Against Fraud and Identity Theft - Cybersecurity Tips | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/cybersecurity/) - The Equifax Cybersecurity Knowledge Center sub-hub is an educational tool containing articles that relate to cybersecurity, threats to your online identity, and how to protect your identity online.
- [Artículos de educación financiera l Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/espanol/) - Ayude a mejorar sus conocimientos y alfabetización financieros con artículos sobre educación financiera, informes de crédito, puntajes de crédito y más.
- [Financial Education and Credit Education Videos | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/financial-education-videos/) - The Equifax Financial Education Videos Knowledge Center sub-hub is an educational tool containing videos that relate to credit, identity theft, personal finance, cybersecurity and more.


### Related to: Credit and Equifax Products FAQ
- [FAQ Articles: Emergency Preparedness | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/help/article-list/-/h/c/emergency-preparedness/) - During a natural disaster or national emergency, you will have a lot of questions. Let Equifax help you with our collection of Emergency Preparedness FAQs.
- [FAQ Articles: Security Freeze | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/help/article-list/-/h/c/security-freeze/) - Do you have questions regarding how to freeze and unfreeze your credit? Equifax is here to help you answer those questions!
- [FAQ Articles: Credit Report Disputes | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/help/article-list/-/h/c/credit-report-disputes/) - Do you have questions regarding credit report disputes? Equifax is here to help you answer those questions!
- [FAQ Articles: Credit Scores and Reports | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/help/article-list/-/h/c/reports-scores/) - Do you have questions regarding your credit report or credit scores? Equifax is here to help you answer those questions!
- [FAQ Articles: Products | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/help/article-list/-/h/c/products/) - Do you have questions regarding your Equifax products? Equifax is here to help you answer those questions!
- [FAQ Articles: Military Personnel | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/help/article-list/-/h/c/active-duty/) - Are you an active duty military member and have questions regarding your credit? Equifax is here to help you answer those questions!
- [FAQ Articles: Fraud Alerts | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/help/article-list/-/h/c/fraud-alerts/) - Do you have questions regarding fraud alerts from Equifax? We are here to help you answer those questions!


### Related to: Credit Report Services Dashboard
- [File a Dispute on Your Equifax Credit Report | Equifax®](https://www.equifax.com/personal/credit-report-services/credit-dispute/) - The Equifax Credit Dispute page allows anyone with a US Equifax credit report to complete a credit report dispute if there is any inaccurate or incomplete information on their Equifax credit report.
- [Place a Fraud Alert or Active Duty Alert | Equifax®](https://www.equifax.com/personal/credit-report-services/credit-fraud-alerts/) - The Equifax Fraud Alert page allows those who are active military or who are victims of identity theft to place a fraud alert on their Equifax credit report, which signals to lenders that they should ask for additional details before proceeding with a credit application.
- [Security Freeze | Freeze or Unfreeze Your Credit | Equifax®](https://www.equifax.com/personal/credit-report-services/credit-freeze/) - The Equifax Security Freeze page allows anyone with a US Equifax credit report to apply, lift, or remove security freezes to their Equifax credit report.
- [Get a Free Credit Report | Equifax®](https://www.equifax.com/personal/credit-report-services/free-credit-reports/) - The Equifax Free Credit Report page allows anyone with a US Equifax credit report to view and download a copy of their Equifax credit report for free.
- [How to Get Additional Copies of Your Equifax Credit Report | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/credit-report-services/multiple-free-credit-reports/) - The Equifax Additional Credit Report Copies page details who qualifies to get additional free copies of their Equifax credit report as well as how to get additional free copies of your credit reports.


### Related to: Credit Monitoring & Reports Pages (Product Comparisons)
- [Compare Equifax Credit Monitoring Products | Equifax](https://www.equifax.com/personal/products/credit/monitoring-product-comparison/) - Compare Equifax credit monitoring products and find the right product to help you keep track of your credit.

<script>
	function initCardSwitches(card_parent)
			{
			card_parent.find('.color_bar_card').each(function()
				{
				initCard($(this));
				});
			}
		function initCard(card)
			{
			if (card.attr('data-switch-active') != 1)
				{
				card.find('.switch').click(function(ev)
					{
					ev.preventDefault();
					});
				card.find('.linear_switch').click(function(ev)
					{
					$('.switch').toggleClass('active');
					
					if ($(this).find('.switch.monthly').hasClass('active'))
						{
						$('.monthly_opt').css('display', 'block');
						$('.annually_opt').css('display', 'none');
						}
					else
						{
						$('.monthly_opt').css('display', 'none');
						$('.annually_opt').css('display', 'block');
						}
						
					return true;
					});
				card.attr('data-switch-active', 1);
				}
			}
		function addCar(elem)
			{
			if (typeof elem.owlCarousel === "function")
				{
				elem.owlCarousel({
					center: true,
					loop: true,
					items: 1,
					margin: 10,
					stagePadding: 35,
					dots: false
					});
				}
			else
				{
				setTimeout(addCar, 100, elem);
				}
			}
		$(document).ready(function()
			{
			initCardSwitches($('.color_bar_features'));
			addCar($('.color_bar_features.owl-carousel'));
			});
</script>

	function getValueByAttribute(node, attr) {
		return (
			node.dataset[attr] ||
			(node.parentElement && node.parentElement.dataset[attr])
		);
	}

	function sendDocumentDownloadedAnalyticsEvent(anchor) {
		var fileEntryId = getValueByAttribute(
			anchor,
			'analyticsFileEntryId'
		);
		var title = getValueByAttribute(
			anchor,
			'analyticsFileEntryTitle'
		);
		var version = getValueByAttribute(
			anchor,
			'analyticsFileEntryVersion'
		);
		var externalReferenceCode = getValueByAttribute(
			anchor,
			'analyticsExternalReferenceCode'
		);

		if (fileEntryId) {
			Analytics.send('documentDownloaded', 'Document', {
				externalReferenceCode,
				fileEntryId,
				groupId: themeDisplay.getScopeGroupId(),
				preview:
					!!window._com_liferay_document_library_analytics_isViewFileEntry,
				title,
				version,
			});

	function handleDownloadClick(event) {
		if (window.Analytics) {
			if (event.target.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
				sendDocumentDownloadedAnalyticsEvent(
					event.target
				);
			}
			else if (
				event.target.parentNode &&
				event.target.parentNode.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a'
			) {
				sendDocumentDownloadedAnalyticsEvent(
					event.target.parentNode
				);
			}
			else {
				var target = event.target;
				var matchTextContent =
					target.textContent &&
					target.textContent.toLowerCase() ===
						'download';
				var matchTitle =
					target.title && target.title.toLowerCase() === 'download';

				);

				);
				var matchParentTitle =
					target.parentNode &&
					target.parentNode.title &&
					target.parentNode.title.toLowerCase() === 'download';
				var matchParentLexiconClassName =
					target.parentNode &&
					target.parentNode.classList.contains('lexicon-icon-download');

				if (
					matchTextContent ||
					matchTitle ||
					matchParentTitle ||
					matchAction ||
					matchLexiconIcon ||
					matchLexiconClassName ||
					matchParentLexiconClassName
				) {
					var selectedFiles = document.querySelectorAll(
